additions: The live style guide authors <sup> markup on listItemDescription/featuredDescription fields (GAAM-764/GAAM-859 examples) but never on any title field (listItemTitle/descriptorTitle/ctaCalloutTitle) — a content gap, not a component defect, since the dialog richtext fields and HTL (@ context='html') both support superscript there too.
Added one instance (card_superscript_title) with a listItemTitle containing <sup>1</sup> so PPDC-010 has real content to exercise instead of self-skipping.
